knowledge: Complete rules and all sampled action results; no hidden recipes, stocks or learned costs. Privileged model inspection; not human or browser play.
scope: This screen predates the newer unified board / exactly one instance of each concept / parents remain proposal. It requires repeat fusions and multiple active copies of concepts. It does NOT validate that newer substrate.

recipes: Earth + Fire = Sun (persistent attraction at contact)
Air + Fire = Wind (a shared directional impulse)
Water + Sun = Nebula (local drag during the response)
rules.worldResponse: Each committed fusion advances the same world by one second. No wait action; no extra recipe prerequisite; all powers available in full-information screen. If the unassisted trajectories already reach both passages, resolve them without another player action.
rules.endpoint: Both wandering worlds must leave through their own visible passage; collision or a wrong exit is terminal.
rules.supplies: Every concept is inexhaustible. Suns coexist and their attraction adds. No cap, cost, score or stock.

search.warning: A found path is a witness. No path is only a bounded-search failure; beam search is not a proof of impossibility. Fusions are not capped by game rules.

rules.intentions: Day seeks nearest Light; Night seeks nearest Shade. A creature at a preferred source stays. Equally near sources cause visible hesitation. Paths and intentions are inspectable. Both move together until they rest; meeting or exchanging places loses.
rules.placeChange: Fusion changes one place to light or shade; the opposing quality is replaced. Existing equal quality is a no-op and advances nothing. All other qualities remain.
rules.goal: Day rests at Right and Night at Left.
rules.supplies: Inexhaustible concepts, no field quota, no quantities, no turn deadline or waiting action.

summary.decision: Reject this four-context slice: the common synchronization chain bypasses context-dependent planning.

limitations: Physics is an original toy, not an astrophysical model.
Continuous physical locations/directions are sampled by the harness; those samples are not restrictions on player powers.
This screen cannot validate the combining gesture, pleasure, readability, novelty or a human inference.
Repeated policy failure does not exclude adaptive uses of one power or a longer universal action sequence.
The sky model permits multiple Suns and repeats a completed recipe; those are incompatible with exactly one instance per concept and novel-combinations-only interaction.
If moving an already-created Sun controls the entire challenge, combining can become cosmetic. This model does not resolve that interaction confound.
